verdict.rationale: Paxos documents programmatic stablecoin transfers, payouts and refunds, plus API credentials whose scopes limit which endpoints can be called. These are developer building blocks and adjacent controls, not a documented agent payment flow. The evidence shows no human-configured spend controls such as per-transaction limits, budgets or approval thresholds for an agent initiating payments.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can move stablecoins under scoped authority — documented agent payment flows where an agent initiates a payment or payout with spend controls a human configured
